svg.title: SafeStitch — Admin User Flow — all 24 screens, admin-only paths in orange

text.tspan: Admin User Flow — all 24 screens, admin-only paths in orange
SafeStitch – Garment Factory Safety Inspection & Corrective Action Tracker
ROLE VIEW — ADMIN · 24 screens · 16 pop-ups/menus · 7 Android/system hand-offs · 170 modelled transitions (142 navigation / back / pop-up / dialog-outcome / hand-off + 28 in-screen state changes)
Kotlin · Jetpack Compose (Material 3) · Navigation-Compose (21 routes) · Room/SQLite · CameraX + ZXing · PDF · roles: Admin, Inspector
Prepared by: Arafat Haque Biswas | Student ID: 24241325
CSE489 – Mobile App Development | BRAC University
Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
Generated 2026-11-15 from app source commit d797895 · TECHNICAL MASTER

g.title: Back / ← : NavController.popBackStack() — returns to the screen underneath
D01 Account menu | Source: ui/dashboard/DashboardScreen.kt | Roles: Admin, Inspector

text.tspan: Shown only on S03 Home, S04 Inspect, S05 Actions and S06
History; any tab switches to the others (popUpTo Home,
⚠ Bug (verified): a tab screen opened from inside Home (KPI
card, Find equipment, scan → History) is restored by the Home
tab instead of the dashboard; System Back recovers.
Return after save / photo (popBackStack to the opener)
← / system Back → previous screen on the stack
Opens a pop-up / menu / permission prompt
Hands off to Android / another app / server
✓ in an arrow label, or '✓ RUN' on a screen = exercised in the Android 16 emulator walkthrough; everything else is traced in source.
ADMIN dashed outline inside a frame = control rendered only when user.isAdmin. Dashed tray under a frame = that screen's pop-ups and hand-offs.
Every screen with ← (and the system Back gesture) returns to the previous screen via NavController.popBackStack(); only non-obvious returns are drawn.
Hover a frame or arrow in the .drawio/.svg to see its route, source file:line, roles and verification status.
• Role checks live in the UI (if (user.isAdmin) …) and in repository guards for users and corrective-action verify/reassign; NavHost routes themselves have no guard — admin screens are reachable only
• Any role may register new equipment: Scan → unknown code → 'New equipment' (S10) → 'Save and start inspection'.
• Scan (S09) pops itself on success and Submit pops the checklist (S11), so Back from the next screen skips them.

• Partial: Safety Assistant Chat and the Home voice note call a hard-coded http://10.0.2.2:3000 dev server (emulator only; cleartext is blocked in release) and otherwise show locally generated/canned text;
RECORD_AUDIO is never requested at runtime.
• Not drawn as screens: InspectionListScreen, CapturedInspectionDetailsScreen and ChatScreen aliases (no callers); DatabaseSeed.seedSampleData (never called). See GAPS-AND-UNVERIFIED-FLOWS.md.

g.title: Corrective-action status transitions (InspectionRepository.transition)

text.tspan: CORRECTIVE-ACTION LIFECYCLE — S15 status changes (one action per failed item, created on Submit in S11)
Not fixed: send back + comment (D06, ADMIN only)
Each step writes an ActionEventEntity (who / when / note), listed under History on S15.
Until VERIFIED, admins can also reassign the responsible person, change priority (resets the due date) or pick a due date (D14/D15).
Inspectors at RESOLVED see 'Only an admin can verify this fix.' — enforced in the UI and in InspectionRepository.requireAdmin().

text.tspan: SCREEN INDEX — every diagram frame ↔ route ↔ source file

g.title: UI visibility vs data-layer enforcement, from the source

text.tspan: ACCESS CONTROL — intended (UI) vs enforced (data layer)
No NavHost route has a guard; ✗ = the action relies on the UI hiding it (an access-control concern).
Add / edit equipment via + / Edit (S04 → S10)
Register equipment by scanning an unknown code
none — Scan › unknown code, any role
Verify / send back / reassign / reschedule action (S15)
